title: Loop Health Registry
description: Universal ecosystem-freshness registry: every scheduled producer must prove liveness or be deliberately disabled for a bounded, mechanically verified window. The monitor turns the board red for dead, failed, stale, activation-mismatched, or unregistered loops.

default_branch.description: Branch whose commit history is authoritative for git_log proof adapters (default-branch evidence). Defaults to 'master' when omitted.

monitors.description: Approved freshness monitors, not producers. Runtime validation constrains this list to the two known guard workflows so arbitrary producers cannot exempt themselves.

loops.description: One entry per scheduled producer workflow. Each entry declares exactly one of proof or bounded disabled state.

workflowFile.description: Bare workflow filename under .github/workflows/, e.g. demerzel-ideation.yml.

schedule.description: Exact cron expressions expected in the workflow. Runtime validation rejects drift between declaration and live YAML.

status.description: Active loops must carry proof and matching cron declarations; disabled loops must carry a bounded block and have no live cron schedule.

note.description: Free-form note (e.g. the remediation that would let a silent-green loop graduate to a proof adapter).

proof.description: How the loop proves it is alive from default-branch repository evidence.

adapter.description: state_glob: newest timestamp in committed JSON/JSONL. git_log: last default-branch commit touching a path. workflow_run: latest completed scheduled GitHub Actions run must be recent and successful.

glob.description: state_glob only: repo-relative glob of committed state files.

timestamp_field.description: state_glob only: the field carrying an ISO-8601 timestamp in each record (top-level object, array element, or JSONL line).

path.description: git_log only: repo-relative path whose last commit dates the loop.

max_stale_days.description: Freshness threshold. Age strictly greater than this many days is stale.

disabled.description: Time-bounded intentional-disable allowlist. Past 'until' the entry is expired and the board turns red so the pause cannot be forgotten.

verification.description: Mechanical proof that the workflow has no cron schedule while disabled.

until.description: Date (inclusive) the disable remains valid through. After this date the entry is an expired disable (red).
